$comment: Shell-owned action an MFE executes against the screen domain to open another screen of the shell — a kit's Overview row to Connections, the Tests kit's spec card to Specs (ADR-0069). The MFE names the screen by its manifest route (presentation.route), which is public in every mfe.json; the shell finds the extension and moves the address as a tab click does. See screenOpenAction.ts.

route.$comment: The target screen's presentation.route, e.g. /projects/specs or /connections.
